description: Send a console command to a running game server. The server must be online. Requires the caller to set `confirm: true`. Surface the exact command text to the user before doing so, since commands can be destructive (e.g. `stop`, `op`, `ban`).

command.description: The raw console command to send, without a leading slash unless the game requires one.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be sent, quoting the exact command and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: send_console_command
title: Send Console Command
